create.name: Maria Furlano
create.bio:
Maria Furlano is an American Qigong teacher and energy intuitive based in Southern California. Her training began at twelve in Taekwon-Do, where she earned a second-degree black belt, and she later trained in bodywork, earned a master's degree in Traditional Oriental Medicine at Emperor's College in Los Angeles and became a licensed acupuncturist in California. She studied Qigong with Master Wan Sujian in Beijing and completed doctoral-level Qigong training through the International Institute of Medical Qigong under Bernard Shannon, where she also taught.

She is the founder of The Art Of Tuning In, an online studio where she teaches breath, movement and meditation as ways of sensing and steadying one's own energy, with particular attention to sensitive people and those who hold space for others. Her teaching covers grounding, energetic boundaries, intuition and seasonal practice rooted in Chinese tradition, offered through live classes, guided audio and private coaching. Since 2019 she has hosted The Art Of Tuning In Podcast, and she shares short Qigong routines and guided meditations on her YouTube channel. She also teaches on The Shift Network.

Soulful 6 Series is sold as supporting 'energy clearing, restful sleep and soul healing'; kept as sleep-as-practice and soul healing (not a condition), but borderline.
Price $25.99 USD is marked 'for a limited time' (normally $30.00 USD).
Name kept as 'Dr. Maria Furlano' because her site calls her Dr. Maria; her doctorate is in Medical Qigong (China), so a human may prefer plain 'Maria Furlano'.

Frequency Tuning private coaching: one-to-one, and its page lists anxiety and burnout recovery.
Shift Network 'New Program With Maria Furlano' (live course, begins March 2027): no title or own URL yet.
Videos 'Simple Qigong & Acupressure Routine for Chest & Shoulder Relief' (relief of pain) and 'Burnout Exhaustion: The Qi Connection' (borderline condition): health-claim rule.
Video 'Simple Qigong to Lower Stress: The Falling Leaf Technique': under 2 minutes (1:54).
Free 'Root the Mind' practice and intuitive-gift quiz: only available by newsletter signup / form, so not listed.
